settings.question: When will I receive my order?
settings.answer: Your order will be shipped in 1-2 business days after your purchase and you will receive it in 2-4 business days.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: We will send the tracking number to you via email after your order has been dispatched. You can track your order from dispached website.

settings.question: What is your exchanges, returns and refunds policy?
settings.answer: Our customers comes always first. If you're unhappy with your order somehow. Just let us now. We'll glad to help you!

settings.question: What happens if my order came damaged?
settings.answer: Unfortunately, these kind of things are happening occasionally, but don’t worry we can send a replacement or according to damage and if you accept we can give you a partial refund.

settings.question: I wanted to order a design but it is out of stock.
settings.answer: We are trying to keep our products stocked all the time but rarely we can go out of stock on some designs. If that happens just wait a couple of days or contact us via hello@morfose.com so we can fasten the things up.

settings.question: Does Morfose test on animals?
settings.answer: We are happy to confirm that the Morfose group of companies has carried out no animal testing since 1981 on the entire range of its products.

settings.question: Are Morfose products hypo-allergenic?
settings.answer: Morfose does not test for or claim that our products are hypoallergenic. If you have a specific allergy, please check product detail page carefully or you can write us hello@morfose.com
